Trusted Partner.name: Trusted Partner
Trusted Partner.description:
🫂 People rely on you and open up to you: allies, victims and strangers alike.

🎯 Good for anyone who wins people over or holds a team together.
📋 Requires level 24 and Cooperativeness 14.

📈 Grants: Cooperativeness +1
Trusted Partner.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has a record of keeping their word and showing up, and people sense it: allies share plans, victims accept help and strangers answer questions. Show it in easy rapport and people who seek them out. Limits: trust is earned person by person; enemies, the prejudiced and anyone they have betrayed are not won over by this.
